ledger.description: Circular import between friday_core.memory.manager and friday_core.skills.builtins.memory via mission_store -> planner -> skill_registry.
ledger.root_cause: Top-level module import of MissionStore in manager.py caused partial initialization failure upon importing tiers/manager.
ledger.fix: Lazy-imported mission_store dynamically inside PersistentMemoryManager.get_task_memory() and protected type annotations with TYPE_CHECKING.
ledger.verification: test_phase8_memory.py and all 15 test suites import cleanly without ImportError.

ledger.description: Python blindly injected vector store knowledge snippets into the user prompt on every request before the Main Model could evaluate intent.
ledger.root_cause: Hardcoded query checks in engine.py (lines 4220-4228) and app.py (lines 176-180) directly modified prompt_text without model consent.
ledger.fix: Eliminated blind injection in engine.py and app.py; Main Model is now the sole authority that decides whether to invoke query_knowledge_base.
ledger.verification: Runtime Mission 12 & 13 verified; user intent preserved without unprompted knowledge injection.

ledger.description: Main Model had no native tool schema to query local RAG knowledge base on demand.
ledger.root_cause: agent_bridge.py omitted a query_knowledge_base function specification, leaving the LLM unable to retrieve indexed documents natively.
ledger.fix: Added query_knowledge_base OpenAPI schema to core_tools in agent_bridge.py and implemented handler in dispatch_agent_tool().
ledger.verification: agent_bridge.py tool schema compilation verified; tool dispatch verified.

ledger.description: Windows file lock error [WinError 32] occurred when attempting to rebuild a corrupted SQLite database.
ledger.root_cause: conn.close() was in an inner finally block after conn.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;'); when PRAGMA failed on a corrupt DB, conn.close() was skipped.
ledger.fix: Restructured _conn_context() with an outer try/finally guaranteeing conn.close() executes regardless of PRAGMA failures, and added gc.collect() in rebuild_database().

ledger.description: Lack of knowledge domain segregation allowed cross-domain contamination between Project, Personal, Technical, and Research data.
ledger.root_cause: Neither SQLite memories table nor document_chunks table had domain indexing or filtering parameters.
ledger.fix: Added KnowledgeDomain enum, domain columns with automatic schema migration, and domain query filtering.

ledger.description: Re-ingesting the same file created duplicate chunks in the vector database, causing bloated results and wasted context.
ledger.fix: Added SHA-256 doc_hash and content_hash computation; identical files in the same domain return existing chunks without duplicate insertion.
ledger.verification: test_knowledge_ingestion.py test_duplicate_ingestion_prevention passed; Runtime Mission 7 verified.

ledger.description: Updating a memory fact did not increment versioning, creating risks of stale memory dominance.
ledger.root_cause: ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE did not track previous versions or mark older records historical.
ledger.fix: Implemented auto-version increment (v1 -> v2) and marked superseded records historical; queries order by updated_at DESC, version DESC.
ledger.verification: test_memory_stale_data.py test_stale_memory_defense_gpu_update passed; Runtime Mission 2 & 12 verified.

ledger.description: Memory deletion could claim success even if the database transaction did not commit or left zombie records.
ledger.root_cause: Deletion only inspected rowcount without independent postcondition absence verification.
ledger.fix: Added immediate readback verification after SQL DELETE; returns True only if absence is independently verified in SQLite.
ledger.verification: test_memory_deletion.py and test_false_memory_success.py passed with 100% absence verification.
